task.goal: What was the total distance covered for swimming activities in the OpenTracks app from October 08 to October 14? Express your answer as a single number in meters rounded to the nearest integer.
task.final_summary: The swimming activities from October 08 to October 14 total 11,008 meters. OpenTracks holds two swimming tracks in that window, both on Oct 8: "More tired than usual today" (2.49 mi) and "Active Rest Day" (4.35 mi), which add up to 6.84 mi as the app's own filtered aggregate for swimming over Oct 8 to Oct 14 confirms. The app displays distance in miles, so 6.84 mi converts to 11,008 m rounded to the nearest integer.
